lessons.title: A New Day (新的一天)
en: Every morning, Xu opens the window and takes a deep breath.
The air is fresh and the sun is warm. Today is a brand new day.
Xu has a simple plan: finish three important tasks, exercise for one hour, and read for thirty minutes.
Small steps every day can create big changes over time.
At night, Xu looks back and smiles. Every day counts.
cn: 每天早上，Xu打开窗户，深深吸一口气。
空气清新，阳光温暖。今天是崭新的一天。
Xu有一个简单的计划：完成三件重要的事，锻炼一小时，阅读三十分钟。
每天迈出的一小步，日积月累就能带来巨大的改变。
晚上，Xu回顾这一天，微笑着想：每一天都算数。

lessons.title: The Little Café (小咖啡馆)
en: There is a little café near the park. It is quiet and warm.
The owner, Aunt Lin, knows every customer by name.
One day, a young man came in and ordered a coffee. He looked tired.
Aunt Lin smiled and said, "Take your time. The coffee is on me."
The man was surprised and grateful. From that day on, he became a regular customer.
Sometimes, a small kindness can change a person's day.
cn: 公园附近有一家小咖啡馆，安静又温馨。
店主林阿姨认识每一位客人的名字。
有一天，一个年轻人走进来点了杯咖啡，看起来疲惫不堪。
林阿姨微笑着说：“慢慢来，这杯咖啡我请你。”
年轻人又惊讶又感激。从那天起，他成了常客。
有时候，一个小小的善意就能改变一个人的一天。

lessons.title: City and Country (城市与乡村)
en: Xu grew up in a small village, but now works in a big city.
The city is exciting. There are tall buildings, bright lights, and endless things to do.
However, the village is peaceful. The air is clean and the nights are quiet.
Xu often thinks about this question: which life is better?
In the end, Xu finds the answer: the best life is the one you choose with your heart.
cn: Xu在一个小村庄长大，但现在在大城市工作。
城市令人兴奋：高楼林立、灯火通明、事情永远做不完。
然而乡村很宁静：空气干净，夜晚安静。
Xu常常思考一个问题：哪种生活更好？
最后，Xu找到了答案：最好的生活，是你用心选择的那一种。

lessons.title: Lesson: Read Day by Day
en: They talked about the future dreams, and the friend shared a valuable piece of advice.
From that day on, Mike started to take a ten-minute walk every morning.
Slowly, small changes began to appear in Mike's life.
At the end of the month, Mike looked back with a quiet sense of pride.
This is the power of small steps. Day by day, we become better versions of ourselves.
cn: 他们聊起了工作与生活的平衡，朋友分享了一条宝贵的建议。
从那天起，Mike每天早上开始练习英语二十分钟。
慢慢地，小小的改变开始出现在Mike的生活里。
月末，Mike带着一份平静的自豪回顾这个月。
这就是小步前进的力量。日复一日，我们成为更好的自己。

lessons.title: Lesson: Write Day by Day
en: Xu gets up early and looks out of the window. The warm spring rain makes Xu smile.
Every day, Xu follows the same simple rule: write down three things to be thankful for.
From that day on, Xu started to take a ten-minute walk every morning.
It was not easy at first, but Xu never gave up.
This is the power of small steps. Day by day, we become better versions of ourselves.
cn: Xu早早起床，望向窗外。清新的空气让Xu露出了微笑。
每天，Xu都遵循同一条简单的准则：睡前阅读三十分钟。
从那天起，Xu每天早上开始散步十分钟。
起初并不容易，但Xu从不放弃。
这就是小步前进的力量。日复一日，我们成为更好的自己。
